text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED: KV-cache continuous-batching surge -> multi-GPU NCCL stalls detected

sre-ana: saw cascading cache growth on tp-sharded kv-cache, started ~08:02 UTC. latency tails spiking to 6-12s, 502s rising.

oncall-ryan: taking ownership, pausing continuous batching on affected fleets now. doing canary rollback to last-known-good batching profile.

eng-ml-jamal: suspected root cause: uneven KV shard partitioning after yesterday's tp-sharder change. some GPUs getting 2-3x more entries -> memory pressure -> page thrash -> NCCL stall.

infra-alex: logs show NCCL timeouts and retransmits, example:
```
[2026-03-15T08:05:12Z] NCCL WARN: ring 0 timeout waiting for p2p
[2026-03-15T08:05:14Z] ncclCommDestroy: hang during barrier
```

support-mae: Customer impact: 3 customers reporting degraded responses (chat timeouts), CS tickets #5678, #5680. Not yet SLA breach but approaching.

cs-liz: escalated to priority and notified account owners. Customers asking if we will roll back.

oncall-ryan: mitigation steps executed:
- paused continuous batching globally for kv-cache service (`cfg:set batching.enabled=false`)
- forced shard rebalance on tp-sharder (`tp-sharder --rebalance --mode=quick`)
- walled to dedicated hosts to reduce cross-tenant noise
Result: tail latency improved after ~40s, 502s down by 60%.

eng-ml-jamal: pushed hotfix candidate to fix shard assignment hashing; will run small canary with 2vms first. patch: https://git.internal/r/kv/tp-sharder/+/fix/shard-hash

deploy-bot: starting canary deploy 2067771240 -> kv-tp-sharder v2.1.5-hotfix on cluster-3

sre-ana: monitoring metrics: token throughput stable, but paging still observed on node-7 for 30s window. keeping an eye.

oncall-ryan: handing off to night oncall @sre-ana at 08:27 UTC. please continue watch and validate hotfix canary.

sre-ana: acknowledged. immediate action items:
1) collect `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` and `dmesg` from nodes with high page faults
2) gather kv-cache shard-size distribution: `python -c "import json; print(json.dumps(get_shard_sizes()))"`
3) confirm rollback path if canary regresses

eng-ml-jamal: note: continuous batching spikes when prefix cache size > 1.2GB per shard; new heuristic will cap prefix caching for those shards until we have more even distribution.

support-mae: will update customers: short blip, mitigation applied, engineering working on hotfix, follow-up timeline ETA 3-4 hours.

cs-liz: request a postmortem draft and list of affected accounts. Also request timeline for Dedicated customers.

oncall-ryan: closing immediate incident channel; new follow-up thread will be in #incidents for postmortem. tagging pager duty incident PD-20260315-09

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigated (partial). monitoring.

sre-ana: last note: if you see NCCL stalls again after hotfix, collect `NVLS` and `nccl-tests` logs and escalate to hw team.

eng-ml-jamal: tracking ticket created: INF-4321. assigning to eng-ml and infra for full fix and test harness for uneven shard distributions.

support-mae: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
